info.description:
REST API for the ORANGE administration console, implemented with Gin and GORM.
Every response uses the envelope {code, message, data, timestamp, traceId}.
Authenticate with the access token returned by POST /auth/login.
info.title: Orange API (Go / Gin / GORM)

post.description: Changes the password of the authenticated user and invalidates all existing sessions.
Authenticates a user and returns an access token. The refresh token is stored in an HttpOnly cookie.
Revokes the current session and clears the refresh cookie.

get.description: Returns the enabled menu tree available to the authenticated user.

parameters.description: Locale used to translate menu names (for example en or zh-CN)
parameters.name: Locale

post.description: Rotates the refresh token cookie and returns a new access token.

get.description: Returns the profile, roles and effective permissions of the authenticated user.
Returns the group tree, optionally filtered by id, name or status. Matching rows keep their ancestors.

post.description: Creates a group under an optional parent group.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of audited HTTP operations.
Returns the permission tree, optionally filtered by id, name, path, status or type.

parameters.description: Permission type filter: menu, directory, action or all
parameters.name: type

post.description: Creates a menu, directory or action permission under an optional parent.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of roles.

post.description: Creates a role and optionally assigns permissions. The response data is the role id.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users.

parameters.description: Matches id, name, username, email or phone
parameters.name: keyword

post.description: Creates a user and returns the generated temporary password in data.
